005package org.wpilib.telemetry;
006
007import org.wpilib.util.protobuf.Protobuf;
008import org.wpilib.util.struct.Struct;
009
010/** A telemetry backend that discards all logged data. */
011public class DiscardTelemetryBackend implements TelemetryBackend {
012  private static final Entry s_entry = new Entry();
013
014  /** Constructor. */
015  public DiscardTelemetryBackend() {}
016
017  @Override
018  public void close() {}
019
020  @Override
021  public TelemetryEntry getEntry(String path) {
022    return s_entry;
023  }
024
025  private static final class Entry implements TelemetryEntry {
026    @Override
027    public boolean isDiscard() {
028      return true;
029    }
030
031    @Override
032    public void keepDuplicates() {}
033
034    @Override
035    public void setProperty(String key, String value) {}
036
037    @Override
038    public <T> void logStruct(T value, Struct<? super T> struct, long timestamp) {}
039
040    @Override
041    public <T> void logProtobuf(T value, Protobuf<? super T, ?> proto, long timestamp) {}
042
043    @Override
044    public <T> void logStructArray(T[] value, Struct<? super T> struct, long timestamp) {}
045
046    @Override
047    public void logBoolean(boolean value, long timestamp) {}
048
049    @Override
050    public void logLong(long value, long timestamp) {}
051
052    @Override
053    public void logFloat(float value, long timestamp) {}
054
055    @Override
056    public void logDouble(double value, long timestamp) {}
057
058    @Override
059    public void logString(String value, String typeString, long timestamp) {}
060
061    @Override
062    public void logBooleanArray(boolean[] value, long timestamp) {}
063
064    @Override
065    public void logShortArray(short[] value, long timestamp) {}
066
067    @Override
068    public void logIntArray(int[] value, long timestamp) {}
069
070    @Override
071    public void logLongArray(long[] value, long timestamp) {}
072
073    @Override
074    public void logFloatArray(float[] value, long timestamp) {}
075
076    @Override
077    public void logDoubleArray(double[] value, long timestamp) {}
078
079    @Override
080    public void logStringArray(String[] value, long timestamp) {}
081
082    @Override
083    public void logRaw(byte[] value, String typeString, long timestamp) {}
084  }
085}
